_meta.description: Unit roster library for the Legion app. Roster placement (faction/rank/legality) is sourced and verified; numeric card stats are NOT yet populated -- see stats_verified per entry and docs/TODO.md.
_meta.verification_status: Roster-level data (name, faction availability, rank, active/removed legality) verified against a live source on 2026-08-22. unit_types and unique are best-effort heuristic guesses flagged with their own *_verified:false flags. All numeric stats (points, wounds, defense, weapons, keywords, upgrade bar) are unpopulated placeholders -- see stats_verified:false on every entry. Known gap: this roster snapshot likely predates several 2026 releases -- tracked in docs/TODO.md.
_meta.mercenary_faction_note: RENAMED 2026-08-23: this faction id is now 'shadow_collective' (previously 'mercenary'), per explicit project-owner instruction ('it's called the shadow collective, the fifth army is'). A unit listing 'shadow_collective' as its only faction is not tied to one of the four core factions (empire/separatist/rebel/republic); it represents a unit intended to be added into any of those armies under the game's Mercenary/Affiliation rules, or fielded in its own all-Mercenary army via the Shadow Collective Battle Force. NOTE: data/factions.json, data/affiliations.json, and data/battle-forces.json still use 'mercenary' as of this update -- per instruction this session touched units.json only. See docs/TODO.md for the resulting cross-file naming inconsistency.

points_gathering_pass.summary: First real points-gathering pass. 15 units (16 after the Bad Batch split) got confirmed current points from official/high-confidence sources -- see each unit's stats.points_verified and stats.points_source. All other stats fields (wound threshold, courage, speed, defense die, weapons, keywords, upgrade_bar) remain unsourced for every unit in this library, including these 16 -- points alone was the achievable target this pass. See docs/TODO.md for why full stat blocks weren't reachable (official card PDFs are image-based, not text-extractable, in this environment).

card_extraction_pass.summary: Full stat blocks merged for 28 existing Empire units and 2 newly-discovered units, from a real card-data extraction the project owner ran against the official AMG Galactic Empire Unit Cards PDF. This is the first batch of a faction-by-faction rollout -- see docs/TODO.md.

card_extraction_pass_history.summary: 25 existing units updated, 1 new units created from real card extraction.

27 existing units updated, 1 new unit created, 2 cross-faction shared units confirmed. This batch's extraction tool omitted speed/defense_die/surge fields -- stats_verified is false for all Rebel-only units in this pass despite good coverage of points/wounds/keywords/weapons.

22 existing units updated, 1 new unit created. Same reduced field set as the Rebel batch (no speed/defense/surge). Confirmed the April 2026 Droideka 'Heavy Droid Trooper' errata is reflected in this PDF, but the STAP Riders 'AI: Dodge' errata is NOT (extract still shows 'AI: Move') -- this snapshot is a mixed vintage, not uniformly pre- or post- the April 2026 update. See docs/TODO.md.

15 existing units updated (12 of those gained 'shadow_collective' added to their factions list), 3 new units created. This completes the faction-by-faction extraction rollout (Empire, Republic, Rebel, Separatist, Shadow Collective all now merged).
